note: Stages apply to every style and target unless they list some. 'optional' stages may be skipped.

workflows.title: Creature or character
workflows.summary: Proportions first, a lofted blockout, then only the detail the style and target need.

stages.goal: Choose head units and place landmarks; get a readable silhouette.
stages.checkpoint: Front and right captures are recognisable from outline alone.

stages.goal: Replace boxes with lofted torso, limbs and head volumes.
stages.checkpoint: Proportions still match; parts overlap where they join.

stages.goal: Refine jaw, brow, muscles and asymmetry without changing topology.
stages.checkpoint: Three-quarter capture shows clear primary and secondary forms.

stages.goal: Optionally fuse parts and add broad surface detail on a copy.
stages.checkpoint: One component, no non-manifold edges.

stages.goal: Build a deformable cage over the dense surface.
stages.checkpoint: Cage within budget with loops at joints.

stages.goal: Add UVs if the look or the engine needs textures.
stages.checkpoint: A checker texture looks even.

stages.goal: Assign a few materials with believable roughness.
stages.checkpoint: Material capture separates skin, cloth and metal.

stages.goal: Add a skeleton only if it must be posed or animated.
stages.checkpoint: A bent joint keeps its volume.

stages.goal: Apply transforms, meet the budget, export and verify.
stages.checkpoint: Triangles within budget and the export opens correctly.

workflows.title: Weapon or hand-held prop
workflows.summary: Blockout from reference proportions, hard-surface shaping, then materials.

stages.goal: Block out blade, guard, grip and pommel as separate parts at true scale.
stages.checkpoint: Front capture reads clearly; part lengths are plausible.

stages.goal: Taper and profile each part; use curves for wrapped grips or curved guards.
stages.checkpoint: Silhouette is distinct and edges are intentional.

stages.goal: Add small bevels so edges catch light.
stages.checkpoint: No non-manifold or zero-area faces in the evaluated mesh.

stages.goal: Add UVs before using image textures.
stages.checkpoint: A checker texture looks even.

stages.goal: Separate metal, wood and leather by metallic and roughness.
stages.checkpoint: Materials are distinguishable in a material capture.

stages.goal: Set the pivot at the grip, apply scale, budget and export.
stages.checkpoint: Within budget and correctly oriented after export.

workflows.title: House, building or environment
workflows.summary: Fix a grid, build a small kit, assemble it, then vary and optimise.

stages.goal: Choose the grid unit and block out footprint, storeys and roof volume.
stages.checkpoint: Top and front captures show the intended footprint and height.

stages.goal: Build wall, door, window, floor and roof modules with corner pivots.
stages.checkpoint: Each module is clean and snaps to the grid.

stages.goal: Assemble with linked duplicates and check alignment.
stages.checkpoint: No gaps or visible overlaps from top and front.

stages.goal: Add trim, props and repeated detail procedurally.
stages.checkpoint: Repetition is not obvious.

stages.goal: Use a few shared materials with UVs at a consistent scale.
stages.checkpoint: Texel density matches across modules.

stages.goal: Share meshes, count triangles, export and verify.
stages.checkpoint: Within budget and instances survive export.

workflows.title: Mechanical or manufactured object
workflows.summary: Primitive blockout, boolean and bevel shaping, then materials.

stages.goal: Block out main volumes at real scale.
stages.checkpoint: Proportions read from front, right and top.

stages.goal: Cut and join forms non-destructively.
stages.checkpoint: Evaluated mesh has no non-manifold edges.

stages.goal: Bevel and check shading.
stages.checkpoint: Edges catch light with no pinching.

stages.goal: Add UVs if needed and assign materials.
stages.checkpoint: Materials are distinct in a material capture.

stages.goal: Apply transforms, budget, export and verify.
stages.checkpoint: Within budget and the export opens correctly.

workflows.title: General modeling
workflows.summary: Choose a technique, block out, refine, then surface.

stages.goal: Pick a technique from the guide index: boxes for planar forms, lofts for limbs, curves for sweeps, modules for repetition.
stages.checkpoint: One technique chosen with a reason.

stages.goal: Block out proportions and silhouette.
stages.checkpoint: Silhouette reads from front and right.

stages.goal: Add detail only where it changes the result.
stages.checkpoint: No mesh errors.

stages.goal: Assign materials.
stages.checkpoint: Material capture looks as intended.

stages.goal: Optimise and export.
stages.checkpoint: The export opens correctly.

workflows.title: Character or creature surfacing
workflows.summary: Zones by anatomy and use, then roughness and fine detail, previewed under fixed light.

stages.goal: Choose the style, the material regions and where each lives.
stages.checkpoint: Skin, cloth, leather and metal regions each have a material slot.

stages.goal: Assign faces to their materials.
stages.checkpoint: A material view shows the regions in the right places.

stages.goal: Set broad color zones with clear value separation.
stages.checkpoint: Main forms separate even when desaturated.

stages.goal: Vary color by anatomy: blood, bone, folds and oil.
stages.checkpoint: Zones are visible but quiet.

stages.goal: Vary roughness so highlights describe each material.
stages.checkpoint: Highlights differ between skin, leather and cloth.

stages.goal: Bake procedural work to images, pack channels, check export support.
stages.checkpoint: Diagnostics report glTF export as supported and the exported file looks right.

stages.goal: Review on the asset under the portrait rig.
stages.checkpoint: Reads at final viewing distance.

workflows.title: Metal, rust and weathering
workflows.summary: Real metal reflectance first, then wear placed by cause, masked consistently across channels.

stages.goal: Create the clean metal with its real reflectance and finish.
stages.checkpoint: It reads as metal on the preview sphere.

stages.goal: Decide where water, hands and impacts act.
stages.checkpoint: Each effect has a cause and most of the surface stays intact.

stages.goal: Add rust or grime with one mask driving color, metallic and roughness.
stages.checkpoint: Rust is rough and non-metallic.

stages.goal: Judge under softboxes or an environment, not one point light.
stages.checkpoint: Reflections describe the shape.

stages.goal: Bake procedural work to images, pack channels, check export support.
stages.checkpoint: Diagnostics report glTF export as supported and the exported file looks right.

workflows.title: Wood
workflows.summary: Grain direction and scale first, then tone variation, finish and relief.

stages.goal: Set grain direction and real-world scale.
stages.checkpoint: Grain follows each plank and has a believable size.

stages.goal: Build rings and grain color variation.
stages.checkpoint: It reads as wood at arm's length.

stages.goal: Set roughness for sealed or raw wood and add gentle relief.
stages.checkpoint: The finish shows in the highlight without noisy bumps.

stages.goal: Bake procedural work to images, pack channels, check export support.
stages.checkpoint: Diagnostics report glTF export as supported and the exported file looks right.

workflows.title: General surfacing
workflows.summary: Choose procedural or image maps, map at scale, then check and preview.

stages.goal: Choose images or procedural nodes for the target.
stages.checkpoint: The choice fits the delivery target.

stages.goal: Set coordinates, scale and color spaces.
stages.checkpoint: Diagnostics report no color-space errors.

stages.goal: Build the material.
stages.checkpoint: The preview matches the intent.

stages.goal: Bake procedural work to images, pack channels, check export support.
stages.checkpoint: Diagnostics report glTF export as supported and the exported file looks right.

workflows.title: Neutral asset or material inspection
workflows.summary: Even, repeatable light that hides nothing and favours no angle.

stages.goal: Use even light with fixed settings.
stages.checkpoint: Turntable rig, Standard view, and the same settings for every asset.

stages.goal: Capture fixed views.
stages.checkpoint: Form, color and defects are visible from all sides.

stages.goal: Fix problems one variable at a time.
stages.checkpoint: Each change was compared with identical settings.

stages.goal: Plan what the engine will light and what is baked.
stages.checkpoint: The asset looks right in the target viewer.

workflows.title: Character portrait
workflows.summary: A motivated key, controlled fill and a rim that separates the subject.

stages.goal: Frame the face with a longer lens.
stages.checkpoint: Eyes sit where the viewer looks first.

stages.goal: Apply the portrait or low-key rig and place the key to model the face.
stages.checkpoint: One clear shadow direction; eyes are readable.

stages.goal: Set fill in stops and rim for separation.
stages.checkpoint: The silhouette separates from the background.

stages.goal: Fix problems one variable at a time.
stages.checkpoint: Each change was compared with identical settings.

stages.goal: Plan what the engine will light and what is baked.
stages.checkpoint: The asset looks right in the target viewer.

workflows.title: Product or reflective prop
workflows.summary: Shape reflections with large sources and keep edges defined.

stages.goal: Frame with margin and a long lens.
stages.checkpoint: The product fills the frame comfortably.

stages.goal: Use softboxes so reflections describe the form.
stages.checkpoint: Highlights follow the curves and edges stay defined.

stages.goal: Choose a background and environment reflections.
stages.checkpoint: Subject and background separate.

stages.goal: Fix problems one variable at a time.
stages.checkpoint: Each change was compared with identical settings.

stages.goal: Plan what the engine will light and what is baked.
stages.checkpoint: The asset looks right in the target viewer.

workflows.title: Night or cinematic scene
workflows.summary: Cool, dim ambient with a few motivated pools of warm or colored light.

stages.goal: Set a dim cool ambient so shadows stay readable.
stages.checkpoint: Shapes are faintly readable with every lamp off.

stages.goal: Add moonlight, windows and practical pools.
stages.checkpoint: A few clear pools lead the eye.

stages.goal: Set exposure and view transform without lifting the night into day.
stages.checkpoint: It reads as night yet the subject is clear.

stages.goal: Fix problems one variable at a time.
stages.checkpoint: Each change was compared with identical settings.

stages.goal: Plan what the engine will light and what is baked.
stages.checkpoint: The asset looks right in the target viewer.

workflows.title: Exterior daylight
workflows.summary: One sun for direction, the sky for ambient, exposure to match.

stages.goal: Set a sky or HDRI and the sun direction.
stages.checkpoint: Shadow direction matches the time of day.

stages.goal: Lower exposure to suit the bright sky.
stages.checkpoint: Sky and shadows both keep detail.

stages.goal: Fix problems one variable at a time.
stages.checkpoint: Each change was compared with identical settings.

stages.goal: Plan what the engine will light and what is baked.
stages.checkpoint: The asset looks right in the target viewer.

workflows.title: Interior
workflows.summary: Daylight through openings, practicals and enough indirect light.

stages.goal: Decide the motivated sources: windows, lamps, screens.
stages.checkpoint: Every light has a believable source.

stages.goal: Light openings with large area lights and set the world.
stages.checkpoint: The room reads without practicals.

stages.goal: Add lamps and their hidden helper lights.
stages.checkpoint: Practicals look like they cause the light.

stages.goal: Set exposure and check noise.
stages.checkpoint: No crushed corners or clipped windows by accident.

stages.goal: Fix problems one variable at a time.
stages.checkpoint: Each change was compared with identical settings.

stages.goal: Plan what the engine will light and what is baked.
stages.checkpoint: The asset looks right in the target viewer.

workflows.title: General lighting
workflows.summary: Start from the subject's size and purpose, then refine.

stages.goal: Decide what the light must show and the mood.
stages.checkpoint: The purpose picks the setup.

stages.goal: Apply a fitted rig or place lights.
stages.checkpoint: The subject is clearly lit.

stages.goal: Fix problems one variable at a time.
stages.checkpoint: Each change was compared with identical settings.

stages.goal: Plan what the engine will light and what is baked.
stages.checkpoint: The asset looks right in the target viewer.
